pain_point: No warehouse stock available in right size
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." The vacancy rate for small warehouses in Melbourne's west is at record lows. These new Truganina warehouses are designed in configurations that suit small businesses. Near Princes Freeway and Port of Melbourne. Stop refreshing real estate listings. Pick your warehouse off the plan and lock it in today.
